correctness.rationale: For prime p and q, J_2(p)=p^2-1 and J_2(2q)=3(q^2-1), so equality is exactly the negative Pell equation p^2-3q^2=-2. The positive-solution classification is reconstructed by a strict descent, not assumed. The cube of the fundamental unit gives a three-step recurrence whose reductions modulo 5 and 3 prove the index obstruction. An independent checker reconstructs the orbit, evaluates J_2 from prime factorization, and performs a bounded all-prime comparison.
